title: pkg_rpm fails when using --incompatible_py3_is_default

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

labels.name: team-Rules-Server
labels.description: Issues for serverside rules included with Bazel

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

`pkg_rpm` rules fail when the `--incompatible_py3_is_default` flag is used. This is the error output:
```
$ bazel build --incompatible_py3_is_default rpm:fake-package
INFO: Analysed target //rpm:fake-package (0 packages loaded, 0 targets configured).
INFO: Found 1 target...
ERROR: /Users/athompson/code/bazel-test-workspace/rpm/BUILD:3:1: MakeRpm rpm/fake-package-x86_64.rpm failed (Exit 1) make_rpm failed: error executing command bazel-out/host/bin/external/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_rpm '--name=fake-package' '--arch=x86_64' '--spec_file=bazel-out/k8-py3-fastbuild/bin/rpm/fake-package.spec' ... (remaining 1 argument(s) skipped)

Use --sandbox_debug to see verbose messages from the sandbox
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/Users/athompson/.cache/bazel/_bazel_athompson/ac1428c9c547e01eac9d076b7db4af52/sandbox/processwrapper-sandbox/1/execroot/__main__/bazel-out/host/bin/external/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_rpm.runfiles/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_rpm.py", line 305, in <module>
    main(FLAGS(sys.argv))
  File "/Users/athompson/.cache/bazel/_bazel_athompson/ac1428c9c547e01eac9d076b7db4af52/sandbox/processwrapper-sandbox/1/execroot/__main__/bazel-out/host/bin/external/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_rpm.runfiles/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_rpm.py", line 297, in main
    return builder.Build(FLAGS.spec_file, FLAGS.out_file)
  File "/Users/athompson/.cache/bazel/_bazel_athompson/ac1428c9c547e01eac9d076b7db4af52/sandbox/processwrapper-sandbox/1/execroot/__main__/bazel-out/host/bin/external/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_rpm.runfiles/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_rpm.py", line 286, in Build
    status = self.CallRpmBuild(dirname)
  File "/Users/athompson/.cache/bazel/_bazel_athompson/ac1428c9c547e01eac9d076b7db4af52/sandbox/processwrapper-sandbox/1/execroot/__main__/bazel-out/host/bin/external/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_rpm.runfiles/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_rpm.py", line 257, in CallRpmBuild
    self.rpm_path = FindOutputFile(output)
  File "/Users/athompson/.cache/bazel/_bazel_athompson/ac1428c9c547e01eac9d076b7db4af52/sandbox/processwrapper-sandbox/1/execroot/__main__/bazel-out/host/bin/external/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_rpm.runfiles/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_rpm.py", line 108, in FindOutputFile
    m = WROTE_FILE_RE.search(log)
TypeError: can't use a string pattern on a bytes-like object
Target //rpm:fake-package failed to build
Use --verbose_failures to see the command lines of failed build steps.
INFO: Elapsed time: 0.945s, Critical Path: 0.76s
INFO: 0 processes.
FAILED: Build did NOT complete successfully
```
This appears to be failing because the `make_rpm.py` binary is only Python2-compatible, but it is being executed with a Python3 interpreter. I suspect this is because its corresponding `py_binary` rule [here](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/0.24.0/tools/build_defs/pkg/BUILD) does not set the `python_version` attribute to `"PY2"`.

### Steps to reproduce

1. `git clone https://github.com/apt-itude/bazel-pkg-rpm-py3-default.git`
2. `cd bazel-pkg-rpm-py3-default/`
3. `bazel build --incompatible_py3_is_default rpm:fake-package`

### What operating system are you running Bazel on?

`CentOS Linux release 7.5.1804`

### What's the output of `bazel info release`?

`release 0.24.0- (@non-git)`

### If `bazel info release` returns "development version" or "(@non-git)", tell us how you built Bazel.

Installed from `vbatts-bazel` COPR repository.
